steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: I think so...

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: The roaring and the heavy breathing have ceased. Did we kill it?

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: But it's still standing—

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Don't move! I'll check.
Mon3tr ascertains that the other two are at a safe distance, and approaches it on her own.

The manglerbeast stands quietly, no sign of the madness that had engulfed it only moments ago, its strange forelimbs hanging still in front of its body. Part of the Originium covering it has been chipped away.
Mon3tr approaches carefully.
She observes the manglerbeast. It was dangerous to begin with, and its mutations make it look strange, almost otherworldly.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: The influence of Originium is turning it into a 'human' physiologically...

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: It must be in a great deal of pain...

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Oh—
But the manglerbeast does not attack or even move from its spot. It falls toward the ground—
Until its forelimbs touch the ground again with a thud.

options: Now's our chance to leave, Mon3tr.
We should leave and go back to the lab, now.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: No, Doctor.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: It's still breathing!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: And it sounds like it's... in pain? I think.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: I can't sense another's emotions like Amiya can, and this is just a mutated animal. But...

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: I know it will die, even if we don't do anything.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: The Originium has impaled its throat. Every part of its body is in pain. It would claw out its own mutated organs if it could.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Perhaps this is why it attacked us. It's not in control of itself anymore.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: I can do it. I can...

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: End its pain.
She walks towards the fallen beast. Standing next to it, she puts her claws against a piece of fur with fewer crystals.
Mon3tr gazes at the manglerbeast with incredible calm in her eyes.
Then, she surgically extinguishes the mutated manglerbeast's last, intermittent breathing.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Let's go, Doctor.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Back to the lab.
Mantra continues to listen.
She knows she cannot trust what she sees, whether it is twisted by intention, or reflecting reality by accident.
And so she listens, until the first word of prayer drops in the crowd like the first snow.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Yurodstvo...

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: 'Gabrielus.'

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Then stop.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Stop—

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Stop it all!

a.text: I cannot stop what never began.
What you see is only in your mind.

steps.text: Mantra stops trying to communicate. She steps forward and tries to steady the trembling red, white and black threads.
As she stretches out her hand—

steps.name: Flickering Voice
steps.text: —Mantra—

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Mantra!

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: You were completely motionless.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: I've never seen you like this... what happened?

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Did you hear that?

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Hear what?
The old woman does not immediately answer.
She looks around and realizes that the remaining miners look different from before. She frowns and glances around herself.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Where is Eloysius?

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: She heard me and ran outside.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: So you did tell us to leave.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Yes, but I don't remember why... this is strange.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Mental Arts.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Are you sure? I've received specific training. I would not be defenseless against such attacks.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Check for short-term memory interference, Raidian.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: What sort of interference?

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Interference that I can create.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: One time, I had Mechanist forget that he wanted to ask you about borrowing Dendie and Axie. Not by wiping the memory, but by blocking its formation.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: I remember... that was the first time you tried to use your Arts like that, I think? We forget when information in our brain is not successfully stored in the memory.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Yes. It was your idea. You are far more experienced than I am in the understanding and utilization of human bioelectrical signals.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: You think someone here uses the same sort of Arts?

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Unsure. Perhaps I just saw and heard more than you did.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: The Yurodstvo of Ursus may be here, Raidian.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Yurodstvo? Why do you bring that up—

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: The Yurodstvo is here? But the last Yurodstvo was burned alive in Grypherburg two years ago. Could another be born so soon?

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: I don't know. I'm going to find out.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: If it's really the Yurodstvo, and it was hidden in the group, without me detecting it... then it's extremely dangerous.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: I'll put the others on alert. Be careful.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: The danger is not physical. Not yet, at least.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: I'll seek help if necessary.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Don't forget it.
Mantra turns around and walks towards the place where the red was, a few moments ago.
The assembled miners either give way to her, or reach out to her.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Who are you... looking for?

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: We're still going, to Grypherburg, right?

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: We'll l-live...

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: (Nods)

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: But they look like, they don't want, to leave? I asked Dyadya Volya. He doesn't want, to leave.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: He'd rather, his wounds rot, than to run.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: But isn't surviving, the most important thing?

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: You're not, talking...

steps.name: Tired Miner
steps.text: Stranger.

steps.name: Tired Miner
steps.text: Are you going to see Nadia? Then go on your knees, and raise your eyes to her.

steps.name: Tired Miner
steps.text: See her, repent, and be forgiven. Then you will realize how foolish you were, for struggling and failing to find peace.
Mantra neither assents nor dissents. She does not speak to them with Arts. She simply nods and passes them by, staring straight into the deepest reaches of the room.

steps.name: Tired Miner
steps.text: You will understand... when you are in her presence.
A hunched, tiny grey-white figure sits at the end of the room like a statue.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: —Yurodstvo?!

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Impossible. It's impossible! The Yurodstvo is dead!

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: The Tsar granted the madman the mercy of defending himself before his sentence was pronounced.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Seven days! He engaged in sophistry for seven days without stopping, without eating or drinking.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: He had the audacity to stand in the middle of the State Council, telling everyone who came to listen—

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: 'I forgive you.'

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: His Imperial Majesty finally had enough and sentenced him to death, personally, but brainwashed believers attempted to raid the execution, resulting in the biggest riot in Grypherburg in a decade.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: We know all that.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: If Mantra said it was the Yurodstvo, she must have had the evidence to make the deduction.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: All we need to do is protect ourselves and wait to hear from her.
Mantra does not kneel as the miners instructed.
She steps into the shadow, facing forward, as though there are a pair of eyes looking backwards in front of her.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: I know you can 'hear'.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: I hope you're more than just a pale imitation of my Arts and my way of speaking, Yurodstvo.

steps.name: Nadia
steps.text: 'Yurodstvo'... if that is the name you need me to have.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Explain.

steps.name: Nadia
steps.text: Gabrielus, Solomida, Bessmert, Aurora, Nadia... or, perhaps, Yurodstvo.

steps.name: Nadia
steps.text: I am all of them.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Why did you hide amongst these suffering people?

steps.name: Nadia
steps.text: Because it is a journey of proselytization.

steps.name: Nadia
steps.text: I shall walk this vast land and redeem the people from their sufferings.

steps.name: Nadia
steps.text: And because I saw and heard her.

steps.name: Nadia
steps.text: I stayed because of her pain.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Who is she?

steps.name: Nadia
steps.text: A suffering soul.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: You deceived her and made her call you 'Nadia'?

steps.name: Nadia
steps.text: I never deceived.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: You lie.

steps.name: Nadia
steps.text: She asked as you did. I answered as I do.

steps.name: Nadia
steps.text: That was all.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: A meaningless response. What are you?

steps.name: Nadia
steps.text: You saw me.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: I see shadow without order.

steps.name: Nadia
steps.text: Yes, I am.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: But not in the eyes of others.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Explain.

steps.name: Nadia
steps.text: People see in me the reflection of their perception and expectation.

steps.name: Nadia
steps.text: I thought, of all the souls, you alone would understand why I exist so.

steps.name: Nadia
steps.text: After all...

steps.name: Nadia
steps.text: You are the unfinished sculpture. You were once to become—

steps.name: Nadia
steps.text: 'Me.'
Mantra keeps her eyes fixed on the strange apparition in front of her, but she is unsure whether she can identify any useful information from it.

steps.name: Nadia
steps.text: A long time ago, you cut away a black piece of rotten flesh.

steps.name: Nadia
steps.text: So did I. It pursued me, and I repelled it, like cutting off a piece of rotten flesh between breaths.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: An absurd analogy.

steps.name: Nadia
steps.text: No, a simple principle.

steps.name: Nadia
steps.text: If it is rotten and no longer connected to the rest of your body...

steps.name: Nadia
steps.text: Why keep it?

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: This is...

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Your memory?

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: But it is mine—

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: No. The Royal Guard... if you can influence a Royal Guard, you can influence the miners.

steps.name: Nadia
steps.text: You killed it. You became me.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: If this is the only thing we share in common...

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: The body, and rotten flesh. Your relationship to the Royal Guard—the Yurodstvo was the source of the Royal Guard experiments.
No sound comes from the trembling shadows, neither affirmation nor denial.
Mantra begins to back off and leaves the shadow's edge.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: ...I need support, Raidian.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: I'm here.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: The conjecture is confirmed.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Also, additional information...

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: The Yurodstvo hid amongst the miners and helped them kill the Royal Guard.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: ...I see.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: What do you need us to do?

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: I need you to continue to contact other Rhodes Island assets in Ursus, and ask Amiya to delay Eloysius.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: We can't leave yet, at least not until I find a way to rouse the miners.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Have Elysium standby inside the range of my Arts. I may need his assistance.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: What's your plan?

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Remove the influence that the Yurodstvo has on the miners.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: You think the Yurodstvo is controlling the miners and causing them to refuse to leave?

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: We cannot kill the Yurodstvo directly, but it can kill anyone here, anytime it chooses to.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Maybe Amiya can help.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Maybe. But Amiya does not understand the Yurodstvo, and I do not want to her to become involved without any understanding.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: The Yurodstvo's powers are similar to mine. This is why I am the only one who can make this decision.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: It relies on the cognition of others to establish itself. I must find the key to its establishment of the 'Nadia' identity, in order to remove its influence.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: You have someone you suspect.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: ...Yes.
Mantra casts her gaze at the surrounding miners, and eventually upon the girl who walks past her to the Yurodstvo.
She mutters in a daze, in bewilderment and sorrow.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: I just need time to confirm.
